title: New Patient Registration Checklist
subtitle: Capture demographics source, contact, representative authority, and privacy acknowledgment; confirm chart match and visit handoff.
description: New Patient Registration records demographics source, contact, representative authority, privacy acknowledgment, chart match, and visit handoff. New Patient Registration evidence stays linked.
use_case: Use this new patient registration stage-gated verification when staff must document demographics source and contact. Reconcile representative authority, privacy acknowledgment, chart match, and visit handoff before the new patient registration handoff. Use registration source documents, demographic confirmation, representative authority, privacy notice receipt, duplicate-record result, communication preference, and check-in handoff. This registration centers chart creation, demographic confirmation, representative authority, communication preference, privacy receipt, duplicate-record prevention, guarantor routing, and front-desk arrival. Ask the assigned new patient registration reviewer to confirm demographics source against the organization's policy.

sections.title: New Patient Registration starting details
sections.guidance: Verify demographics source, contact and representative authority, communication preferences, privacy acknowledgment, chart match, guarantor route, and visit handoff.

blocks.label: New Patient Registration required checks
items: Demographics source is identified for this record
Contact matches the current request or source
Representative authority is ready for point-of-use staff
Privacy acknowledgment limits or questions are resolved
Chart match is communicated to the responsible person
Visit handoff is confirmed at handoff
A changed new patient registration fact is returned for review
